description: This file defines the MiniKeyboardActionListener class, which implements the OnKeyboardActionListener interface to handle keyboard actions within a mini keyboard component of an Android application. It manages event forwarding, dismissing the keyboard, and handling specific key events.

classes.name: MiniKeyboardActionListener
classes.description: A class implementing OnKeyboardActionListener to handle mini keyboard events, forwarding actions to a parent listener, managing dismissal, and handling specific key interactions.

classes.name: MiniKeyboardActionListener.OnKeyboardActionListenerProvider
classes.description: An interface providing a method to retrieve the current OnKeyboardActionListener.

methods.name: MiniKeyboardActionListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with a parent listener provider and a keyboard dismiss action.

methods.name: setInOneShot
methods.description: Sets whether the listener is in one-shot mode, affecting dismissal behavior.

methods.name: onKey
methods.description: Handles key press events, forwarding to the parent listener and dismissing the keyboard if conditions are met.

methods.name: onMultiTapStarted
methods.description: Notifies that multi-tap has started.

methods.name: onMultiTapEnded
methods.description: Notifies that multi-tap has ended.

methods.name: onText
methods.description: Handles text input events, forwarding to the parent listener and dismissing if in one-shot mode.

methods.name: onTyping
methods.description: Handles typing events, forwarding to the parent listener and dismissing if in one-shot mode.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of input, dismissing the keyboard.

methods.name: onSwipeLeft
methods.description: Swipe left gesture handler (empty implementation).

methods.name: onSwipeRight
methods.description: Swipe right gesture handler (empty implementation).

methods.name: onSwipeUp
methods.description: Swipe up gesture handler (empty implementation).

methods.name: onSwipeDown
methods.description: Swipe down gesture handler (empty implementation).

methods.name: onPinch
methods.description: Pinch gesture handler (empty implementation).

methods.name: onSeparate
methods.description: Separate gesture handler (empty implementation).

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Handles key press down events, forwarding to the parent listener.

methods.name: onRelease
methods.description: Handles key release events, forwarding to the parent listener.

methods.name: onFirstDownKey
methods.description: Handles the first down event for a key, forwarding to the parent listener.

methods.name: onGestureTypingInputStart
methods.description: Handles the start of gesture typing input; returns false indicating no gesture in mini keyboard.

methods.name: onGestureTypingInput
methods.description: Handles gesture typing input events (empty implementation).

methods.name: onGestureTypingInputDone
methods.description: Handles completion of gesture typing input; returns false.

methods.name: onLongPressDone
methods.description: Handles long press completion, forwarding to the parent listener.
